f102b31021d8549dc50aa13fe88a4909d1a921f8.sourceText: 这来自北极熊原包的设计：先用一个朝向较稳定的虚拟系供导航计算，再把速度转换到实际云台系；`cmd_spin` 用于叠加底盘自旋。[北极熊原包说明](https://github.com/SMBU-PolarBear-Robotics-Team/pb2025_sentry_nav/blob/main/fake_vel_transform/README.md)、[原包速度转换源码](https://github.com/SMBU-PolarBear-Robotics-Team/pb2025_sentry_nav/blob/main/fake_vel_transform/src/fake_vel_transform.cpp)。这是这套工程的约定，不能认为所有 ROS2 的 `cmd_vel` 都按云台系表达。
f102b31021d8549dc50aa13fe88a4909d1a921f8.translatedText: This comes from the design of the original Polaris package: first use a relatively stable virtual frame for navigation calculations, then convert the velocity into the actual gimbal frame;`cmd_spin` used to superimpose chassis spin\.[Polaris original package description](https://github.com/SMBU-PolarBear-Robotics-Team/pb2025_sentry_nav/blob/main/fake_vel_transform/README.md)、[original package velocity conversion source code](https://github.com/SMBU-PolarBear-Robotics-Team/pb2025_sentry_nav/blob/main/fake_vel_transform/src/fake_vel_transform.cpp)。This is the convention of this project; it cannot be assumed that all ROS2's `cmd_vel` are expressed in the gimbal frame\.

f1072e18047e9d34bb9156e8c3b4819a422dcdd4.sourceText: 地图匹配结果是“目标地图←输入累计点云”的变换；输出直接命名为 `map→odom`。要使这个名字正确，必须先保证目标PCD和输入实际坐标符合约定；本节点没有另行变换到这两个名称指定的系。
f1072e18047e9d34bb9156e8c3b4819a422dcdd4.translatedText: The map matching result is the transformation from "target map ← input accumulated point cloud"; the output is directly named `map→odom`\. To make this name correct, the target PCD and the input actual coordinates must first conform to the convention; this node does not separately transform into the frames specified by these two names\.

f11a83b7bc81b0d22bd953fb49897b4faf3d2e6c.sourceText: 在函数形参列表中，可以加==const修饰形参==，防止形参改变实参
f11a83b7bc81b0d22bd953fb49897b4faf3d2e6c.translatedText: In a function parameter list, ==const can be added to qualify a parameter== to prevent the parameter from modifying the argument\.

f138354088bb959f8f54ab2b90c8d8dc3a373544.sourceText: 多继承可能会引发父类中有同名成员出现，需要加作用域区分
f138354088bb959f8f54ab2b90c8d8dc3a373544.translatedText: Multiple inheritance may cause members with the same name to appear in parent classes, requiring scope qualification to distinguish them\.

f16a6a006f19937c979eeab95286d4162bd22c81.sourceText: 这与从当前扫描建图的用途一致。
f16a6a006f19937c979eeab95286d4162bd22c81.translatedText: This is consistent with the purpose of mapping from the current scan\.
